property_summary: For any caller and any sent value, when the reference contract's play() is invoked only the exact TICKET_AMOUNT (10) is accepted and if accepted the contract's pot increases by that amount (so address(c).balance equals pot + bank_withdrawn_effects); the mutant that requires FEE_AMOUNT (1) will accept calls with value 1 and thus for some fuzzed payable amount the property's assumption about accepted payment amount and resulting pot change is violated.
change_summary: Require exactly the fee amount instead of the ticket amount, making play only accept FEE_AMOUNT and changing pot accumulation and payouts.
